production.verify: sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD); st=; for i in $(seq 1 18); do u=$(gh api "repos/companyboost/Esportstrading/deployments?sha=$sha" --jq '.[0].statuses_url // empty'); [ -n "$u" ] && st=$(gh api "$u" --jq '.[0].state // empty'); [ "$st" = success ] || [ "$st" = failure ] || [ "$st" = error ] && break; sleep 10; done; echo "vercel deploy: ${st:-not found}"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "site: %{http_code}\n" https://esportstrading.vercel.app/

notes: Static site, no build step. Pushing main to companyboost/Esportstrading auto-deploys to Vercel production (esportstrading.vercel.app) through the Git integration, so there is no vercel CLI step and no staging. John pushes straight to main once he approves a change, so no confirm prompt. Push as the companyboost GitHub account; the other accounts on this Mac have no push rights. Options pages (*-options.html) and their assets ship too, so John can review them on his phone.
